question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07781a5f616539253239096744fc6ec821547d330be79faddb587ed124b336a2.png]
solution:
**The logic followed here is: **Power = Number of circles + 1 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60d796132a8f0e7522b494ff8523acbc4ccc23d12db336966500977c230fccb9.png] 

 

⇒ a⁽¹⁺¹⁾ + b(2+1) + c(3+1)

⇒ a2 + b3 + c4

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec154f88d5a849da1e9565b5233a249ca1ece54e1790ae1b5ddc14f3b2184daa.png] 

⇒ 3(2+1) + 4(3+1) + 2(4+1)

⇒ 33 + 44 + 25

⇒ 27 + 256 + 32

⇒ **315**

Hence,** "Option 2" **is the correct answer.
